description:
Analyze the stall characteristics of the NREL 5MW Reference turbine at a fixed rotational speed. 

1. Open QBlade and load the 'NREL_5MW_Reference.wpa' project from '/home/ga/Documents/sample_projects/'.
2. Navigate to the 'HAWT BEM Simulation' module.
3. Configure a dimensional simulation (Range Simulation) with the following parameters:
   - Variable: Wind Speed
   - Range: 5 m/s to 25 m/s (Step: 1 m/s)
   - Parameters: Fixed Rotational Speed of 9 RPM (NOT optimal/variable speed)
   - Pitch: 0 degrees
4. Run the simulation. You should see the power curve rise and then flatten or drop (stall).
5. Export the simulation results (the graph data) to '/home/ga/Documents/projects/stall_simulation_data.txt'.
6. Identify the Peak Power (in kW or MW) and the Wind Speed at which it occurs. Create a text file report at '/home/ga/Documents/projects/stall_report.txt' containing these two values.
7. Save the project with results as '/home/ga/Documents/projects/stall_analysis.wpa'.
